destination_grouping_rationale: Eight mutually exclusive shared categories keep both degree panels readable while preserving scientific R&D services, hospitals and health-practitioner offices separately. Government functions are pooled, as are non-R&D consulting/professional services and the remaining industries. Manufacturing includes nonmedical instrument establishments, so its label does not imply exclusively medical manufacture. The full detailed classification is retained in SM5.
outside_definition_label_caveat: NAICS 611310 is the approved main exclusion. Junior colleges are separately coded 611210 and remain in this main definition; other educational services may therefore include college teaching. An SM sensitivity additionally excludes 611210. Do not equate the main subset with no academic employment or affiliation.
occupation_reporting_rule: Named occupations require n >= 5 within the displayed degree-by-role or degree-by-destination breakdown; pool smaller cells, retain unavailable separately. Detailed individual small cells remain private. This rule does not suppress RC-RMI states or common destination rows.
distribution_note: Public-methods derivative: private source locations and fingerprints are omitted; aggregate values, rules and stated limitations are retained. Historical execution metadata does not establish rerun capability.
scored_input_scope: Underlying individual scored records are withheld. Supplied aggregate plot data reproduce the displayed summaries.
